neighbours.label: expectation about whether a thing will behave or work: the verb / auxiliary after 'expect it', 'hoped it', 'keeps', 'doesn't' ('expect it to go down', 'hoping it sells', 'it keeps not getting bought')
fire: When you drop a glass, you expect it to shatter.
We sowed the grass and hoped it would come up.
The old printer keeps jamming every morning.
They listed the house and hoped it would sell quickly.
If the app doesn't load, clear the cache.
I wound the clock and expected it to run all week.
The engine keeps stalling at red lights.
Even if the plan does fail, we have a backup.
quiet: When you drop a glass, you sweep up the pieces.
We sowed the grass and watered it every evening.
The old printer sits in the corner of the office.
They listed the house and moved to the coast.
If the app looks strange, take a screenshot.
I wound the clock and set it on the shelf.
The engine sits under a red cover.
Even with the plan, we have a backup.
